description: Install a chosen LlamaIndex/LlamaHub package (pip) into the LlamaIndex RAG plugin venv. Only the literal pip command runs, after you approve it. The package name comes from the plugin's bundled list.

steps.description: pip install the selected LlamaIndex package into ~/.mobilessh/llamaindex/venv (creates the venv if the RAG plugin has not yet).
steps.run: set -e; VENV="$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaindex/venv"; test -x "$VENV/bin/pip" || python3 -m venv "$VENV"; "$VENV/bin/pip" install "{{package}}"

uninstall.description: Best-effort pip-uninstall the packages this plugin can install (from the shared venv).
uninstall.run: V="$HOME/.mobilessh/llamaindex/venv"; test -x "$V/bin/pip" && "$V/bin/pip" uninstall -y llama-index-readers-file llama-index-readers-web llama-index-readers-database llama-index-readers-github llama-index-readers-google llama-index-readers-slack llama-index-readers-notion llama-index-readers-s3 llama-index-readers-confluence llama-index-readers-wikipedia llama-index-readers-youtube-transcript llama-index-packs-recursive-retriever llama-index-packs-sentence-window-retriever llama-index-packs-corrective-rag || true
